candidate_name: Mayaguez LNG Import Terminal (PREPA IRP West-region proposal)
sponsor_or_proposer: Puerto Rico Electric Power Authority (PREPA) — utility planning entity; no named terminal developer
current_state: IRP scenario only. PREPA's preferred plan (and IRP Scenario 4) contemplates a new LNG import terminal plus new gas generation in the West region near Mayaguez, supplied by ships. RMI and IEEFA note the IRP's own analytical-optimization scenarios never selected these terminals as economically justified, and the regulator (Puerto Rico Energy Bureau) has not approved a Mayaguez terminal. No developer named, no site selected, no FERC filing/permit/FEED.
missing_threshold_elements: sponsor (no specific terminal developer — PREPA is the offtaker/planner); concrete step (no site selection, FERC pre-filing, RFP award, permit, or FEED — exists only as an IRP planning scenario the regulator/analysis treats as unjustified)
watch_for: A named developer or FSRU charter for the West region; a PREB order or 3PPO RFP specifically procuring a Mayaguez terminal (vs. gas supply only); a FERC pre-filing; site selection near Mayaguez.
notes: Recheck ~6-12 months. PREPA's gas footprint is currently served by NFEnergia (San Juan) and EcoElectrica (Penuelas), both already in GEM; the 2025 procurement (3PPO-RFP-1125-17-MSIN, awarded to NFE) is a multi-site GAS SUPPLY contract, not a new terminal. Distinct from the also-proposed Yabucoa (East) terminal in the same plan.

candidate_name: Yabucoa LNG Import Terminal (PREPA IRP East-region proposal)
sponsor_or_proposer: Puerto Rico Electric Power Authority (PREPA) — utility planning entity; no named terminal developer
current_state: IRP scenario only. PREPA's preferred plan (and IRP Scenario 4) contemplates a new LNG import terminal plus new gas generation in the East region near Yabucoa, supplied by ships. Same posture as the Mayaguez proposal: no developer named, no site selected, no FERC filing/permit/FEED; analysis/regulator treat it as not economically needed. GE Vernova LM2500 turbine order for the Yabucoa PREPA power plant (via RG Engineering / Genera PR) is grid modernization, not an LNG import terminal.
missing_threshold_elements: sponsor (no specific terminal developer); concrete step (IRP planning scenario only — no site selection, FERC pre-filing, RFP award, permit, or FEED for a terminal)
watch_for: A named developer or FSRU charter for the East region; a PREB order or RFP specifically procuring a Yabucoa terminal; a FERC pre-filing; site selection near Yabucoa.
notes: Recheck ~6-12 months. Distinct from the Mayaguez (West) terminal proposal. Power-plant turbine procurement at Yabucoa does not on its own imply a new terminal — gas can be trucked/barged from existing terminals.
